name: expense-webapp
description: The browser app for all three actors: employees file and follow claims, managers decide their team's claims, finance exports approved claims and sets line managers. One bundle with role-gated screens, because the three share one product and lifecycle. It holds no data or secrets and does not integrate with payroll.

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Loads and changes claims, team decisions, people and exports.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs users in through the platform's single sign-on.
